games.title: Rise of the Soul-Bound Constructs
games.subtitle: A Homebrew Adventure
games.short_description: Investigate rogue constructs in a dwarven kingdom shaped by wealth, techno-arcana, and buried political tension.
games.description: You have been commissioned to investigate the disappearance of rogue constructs in the Obsidian Peaks, a land touched by the promise of techno-arcana under the rule of a wealthy dwarven merchant-king.
games.full_description:
You have been commissioned to investigate the disappearance of rogue constructs in the Obsidian Peaks, a land touched by the promise of techno-arcana under the rule of a wealthy dwarven merchant-king.

The Dwarven Kingdom hidden within the Obsidian Peaks has recently entered a period of unprecedented prosperity and wealth with the naming of the most recent King. Techno-Arcana is a rampantly growing field of technology and innovation, boasting constructs with nearly infinite energy and capability. This period of prosperity and peace is in great peril though as reports have made it to the capital city of constructs going rogue, attacking their owners and fleeing into the depths of the mountain.

The Molten Throne has been the seat of every Dwarven king since the Shatterbane clan laid claim to the Obsidian Peaks. Five years ago the last Shatterbane King passed of old age, and for the first time in dwarven history a member of the Shatterbane clan was not named king. The throne passed instead to the young Svei Silvertongue, the most successful merchant of the entire clan.

Svei quickly transformed the kingdom into an economic powerhouse on the continent, using his new and impressive Techno-Arcana to build constructs with no equal competitor. At the same time, the Shatterbane clan were seen less and less frequently within the capital, becoming reclusive carriers of forgotten traditions. It is far from a secret the disdain they hold for the new king, and it is suspected that they may be to blame for the recent spike in construct attacks.

Are those bound to tradition and old ways at fault, or is the greed of those already in power blinding them to the truth?
inspirations: Fire Coming out of the Monkey’s Head by Gorillaz

games.title: Empire Records
games.subtitle: Damn The Man
games.short_description: A silly, heartwarming 90s-inspired adventure about saving your record store before midnight.
games.description: Inspired by Empire Records, Dazed and Confused, and Can't Hardly Wait, this adventure mixes heart, chaos, and 90s energy.
games.full_description:
Damn The Man is inspired by movies like Empire Records, Dazed and Confused, and Can't Hardly Wait. It is silly, heartwarming, and packed with 90s energy. No experience is needed to enjoy the game.

Set in 1995, you will juggle the responsibilities of a day that will determine the future of your record store, all while trying to accomplish your big personal goal.

Can you confess your love to your crush and find the money that went missing from the cash box? Can you pay off your debt to your parents while promoting tonight's big show?

The clock is ticking and you have got until midnight to try.

games.title: Call of Cthulhu
games.subtitle: Eat Your Heart Out
games.short_description: A speed-dating night in Holmouth turns into a race against time, horror, and unraveling sanity.
games.description: A Call of Cthulhu mystery set in Holmouth, New Hampshire, where not everyone at a local speed-dating event leaves with heart and mind intact.
games.full_description:
Our story takes place in Holmouth, New Hampshire. Holmouth is a fictional town on the coast of New England where many secrets lie hidden.

Eat Your Heart Out is a race against time. We begin at Gannets restaurant for a local speed dating event where lonely souls can find someone to give their hearts to. Not all is as it seems at this event. There are those who wish to meddle in things that ought to be left alone.

Can you escape with your heart and mind unbroken?

Call of Cthulhu is centered around investigating cosmic horrors and attempting to maintain sanity in a world of madness. Characters are ordinary people facing secrets humanity was never meant to know. The true horror lies in the unknown, psychological torment, and the realization that people are nothing compared to the things they were never meant to understand.

games.title: The Fall of Itzli
games.short_description: A New England mystery of earthquakes, disappearances, and ritual killings. 2 seats claimed, 4 still open.
games.description: A New England mystery where strange disasters and quiet denial hint at deeper horrors moving beneath the surface.
games.full_description:
December 13, 1926. 1:30 AM. Holmouth, New Hampshire.

Shortly after 1:30 AM a 4.5 earthquake was felt directly northwest of Holmouth. Minor damage was reported from local homes and businesses. Residents later claimed to see smoke and a large black shadow northwest of town. Further investigation revealed The Holmouth Institute in flames. Four deceased patients were found on the grounds while the fire brigade attempted to extinguish the blaze. The historic mausoleum on the grounds was also partially destroyed.

The quiet towns of New Hampshire have gone through a few rough years. Mysterious disappearances, ritual killings, unexplained earthquakes. The residents seem to have become accustomed to these kinds of events.

No one thinks these events are related. Unfortunate circumstances, that is what people say. But work is being done in the shadows. There may be more to these stories than meets the eye.

Will anyone investigate further?

games.title: Strixhaven: Freshman Year
games.subtitle: Curriculum of Chaos
games.short_description: A beginner-friendly magic school adventure where students uncover mysteries beneath Strixhaven University.
games.description: A D&D 5e magic school adventure set at Strixhaven University, launching in late May.
games.full_description:
Dear Prospective Student,

It is our pleasure to announce your formal acceptance to the multiverse's premier magical university, Strixhaven. Here, you will join one of five magical colleges in your pursuit of knowledge and power: Lorehold, Prismari, Quandrix, Witherbloom, or Silverquill.

Whether you seek to unravel the mysteries of The Weave, wield unimaginable cosmic power, or simply get better at talking to ghosts, we can assure you that your time here will be nothing short of inspirational. Please note that Strixhaven University accepts no liability for student death or dismemberment due to eldritch explosions, mauling by magically augmented beasts, or abduction by sinister secret societies.

Once more, congratulations on your acceptance. We look forward to your arrival. Strixhaven, Arcavios awaits.

This adventure covers freshman year of a modified version of Curriculum of Chaos. Players begin to navigate academic life while uncovering the larger mystery beneath the surface of their magical studies at Strixhaven.

Strixhaven offers a fun magic-school D&D experience that is beginner friendly while still offering plenty for seasoned players to enjoy.
games.schedule: Days and times TBD, launching late May

games.title: Twilight: 1984 - Survival in Summerville
games.short_description: Small town life collapses after invasion in a Cold War survival story of sacrifice, trust, and resistance.
games.description: The year is 1984 and the Cold War has turned hot. Suddenly, small town life is turned upside down in the aftermath of invasion.
games.full_description:
The year is 1984 and the Cold War has turned hot. Suddenly, small town life is turned upside down in the aftermath of invasion.

This is a story of survival and sacrifice in a narrative storytelling game with a sprinkle of base building and small unit tactics, inspired by Red Dawn, Jericho, and Alas, Babylon.

You will play as one of Summerville’s townsfolk. As the world collapses around you, survival will depend on more than stockpiled cans and loaded shotguns. You will need to rally neighbors, forge alliances, and decide who can be trusted.

Your actions will determine the fate of Summerville. Good luck, you are on your own.
games.schedule: Every other Wednesday, 6–9 PM, launching early June

games.title: Palace of Shade: Doorway to Wonderland
games.short_description: A Feywild adventure of dangerous beauty, strange etiquette, fairy-tale logic, and impossible roads into Wonderland.
games.description: You have been invited to the Palace of Shade, a glittering fey court where every smile hides a secret and every rule changes depending on who is watching.
games.full_description:
You have been invited to the Palace of Shade, a glittering fey court where every smile hides a secret, every compliment may carry a price, and every rule changes depending on who is watching.

What begins as an elegant night of music, dancing, strange etiquette, and dangerous beauty soon turns into something far greater than a simple courtly celebration. The palace is full of powerful fey nobles, impossible magic, whispered grudges, and guests who may not be what they seem.

Beyond the palace walls waits the Wilds, a living realm of shifting paths, beautiful threats, and fairy-tale logic. Mortals who step too deeply into fey business rarely leave unchanged.

This adventure begins with a mysterious night at the Palace of Shade and opens the door to a larger journey through Wonderland, where fairy-tale logic, dangerous archfey, strange bargains, and impossible roads wait beyond the edge of the mortal world.

The Feywild is not a place you simply visit. It is a realm of impossible color, living magic, old promises, and beautiful danger. Roads do not always lead where they should. Names matter. Gifts have consequences. A harmless question can become a binding agreement if spoken in the wrong room.

The Palace of Shade stands as one of the strange jewels of the fey court, a place where nobles gather to celebrate, scheme, flirt, insult, bargain, and measure one another with smiles sharp enough to draw blood.

You arrive as honored guests, curiosities, or perhaps entertainment. In the eyes of the court, mortals are brief, fragile things. Useful sometimes. Amusing often. Dangerous only when underestimated.

But something is wrong beneath the glamour. The music is too perfect. The shadows are too long. The flowers are beginning to pale. Somewhere in the palace, a secret is waiting to be found.

And beyond this one enchanted night lies Wonderland: a deeper Feywild realm where fairy tales turn cruel, roads follow emotions instead of maps, and the favor of an archfey may be the difference between survival and ruin.

Step carefully. In the Feywild, the story always notices when you enter.
